testcase.name: a waypoint's id survives the round trip rather than being regenerated
a waypoint's track link and designation round-trip through the forager extension
a waypoint from a file with no forager extension gets a fresh id, not an empty one
an ordinary waypoint with no track link carries only its id in the extensions block
a waypoint round-trips through encode and decode with name and note intact
the full record round-trips through encode and decode with every field and verdict intact
a track round-trips through encode and decode with lat, lng, altitude, and timestamp intact
a document with no track decodes with a null track
a document with no declared rule set writes no rule attribute at all
the full record declares its rule set and names the rule on excluded points only
an empty full record encodes no extensions block and decodes back to empty
special characters in names are escaped and survive the round trip
a full record written before the rule attribute decodes with no rules, not this build's
